sessions.summary: Code review PR #192 (doc-only: Visibility field + PersistenceGate decision on ApplicationUpgrade epic). Ran mattpocock-skills:code-review two-axis review. Standards found 2 findings (duplicated Visibility type, Divergent Change). Spec found 3 findings (undeclared file, test coverage gaps, missing comment). 3 review comments posted to PR #192 via gh CLI.

Security audit (SDOL-011) of Ontology Editor codebase: 9-area review covering JWT auth layer, API endpoints, HANA SQL patterns, SPARQL construction, AI Core prompts, external connectors, frontend XSS surface, and existing security controls. Key findings: auth solid (parameterized SQL, XSUAA, role Depends); MCP_AUTH_DISABLED lacks CF production guard; /query/sparql endpoint lacks rate limiting and complexity cap; SPARQL FILTER escaping incomplete; user input injected raw into NL-to-SPARQL LLM prompt. Audit artifact saved to docs/documents/security/SDOL-011-security-audit.md.
